final: SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio, (SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3)) - (SELECT AVG(source_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(s2.aream2) / SUM(s2.volm3) AS source_ratio FROM scanspatial s2 JOIN projects p2 ON s2.arcref = p2.arcregistry WHERE p2.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND s2.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s2.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s2.volm3 <> 0 GROUP BY p2.fundflux)) AS above_average_by FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux HAVING SUM(s.aream2) IS NOT NULL AND SUM(s.volm3) IS NOT NULL AND SUM(s.volm3) <> 0 AND SUM(s.aream2) / SUM(s.volm3) > (SELECT AVG(source_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(s2.aream2) / SUM(s2.volm3) AS source_ratio FROM scanspatial s2 JOIN projects p2 ON s2.arcref = p2.arcregistry WHERE p2.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND s2.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s2.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND s2.volm3 <> 0 GROUP BY p2.fundflux)) ORDER BY p.fundflux
